title: Ɔbɔfo a Ɔhyiaa Abosonsomfo no
intro: Wɔ bere bi a na ahofama ayera mu no, ɔbɔfo bi sɔree a ɔfrɛɛ no ​​sɛ ɔnsan nkɔ wiase nyinaa Awurade som mu. Saa onipa yi gyinaa pintinn tiaa nkurɔfo a wɔagye ntini wɔ atoro nyame som mu, na ɛkaee wɔn wɔn nokware Bɔfo ne wɔn agyanom Awurade. Nanso nkurɔfo no anyɛ aso na wɔpow kɔkɔbɔ no, na wɔsɔɔ wɔn ankasa nkrabea ano. Hena ne ɔfrɛfo a onhinhim yi?
clues: Wɔsomaa me kɔɔ nkurɔfoɔ bi a wɔatwe wɔn ho afiri Nokware Nyankopɔn Baako no kwan so.
Mefrɛɛ wɔn sɛ wonnyae atoro nyame bi a wɔfrɛ no Baal som.
Me nkurɔfo poo me frɛ no na wɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ wɔn abosonsom.
Esiane wɔn pow nti, akyinnye biara nni ho sɛ wɔde wɔn bɛba ama wɔatwe wɔn aso.
M’Awurade maa me asomdwoe ne nkaeɛ a nhyira wom wɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛdi akyire no mu.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii

trial.answer: Ɔfrɛɛ ne nkurɔfo sɛ wonnyae Baal

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ

outcome.answer: Wɔmaa asomdwoe ne nkae a nhyira wom

verse: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers, (37:123)
